description: Changes ONE block on the registration or thank-you page of a webinar: its text, or its image. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. Participants see it on their next visit; nothing else on the page moves. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id` and `path`, which comes from wi_get_webinar_page_blocks, plus `text` for a text block or `image_url` for an image block. A block that carries its own formatting never loses it silently: when the spot is not unambiguous the site refuses with code formatting_would_be_lost and writes nothing. For the visible page heading use wi_change_webinar_text with target page_heading, for a text of the campaign copy (not the page) target journey_field.

confirm.description: Only after the site answered code admin_editing: the host agreed to overwrite unsaved changes in wp-admin.

image_alt.description: The alt text of the new image.

image_id.description: The media library id of the new image, if you have it.

image_url.description: The new image address for an image block.

path.description: The block path, exactly as wi_get_webinar_page_blocks returned it.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

surface.description: Which page the block stands on. Default registration.

text.description: The new text for a text block: paragraph, heading, list item, quote or button.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_webinar_page_block
title: Change one block on a webinar page
